Class LedMatrixShapes

java.lang.Object
io.github.jabrena.juno.api.LedMatrixShapes
public final class LedMatrixShapes extends Object
Draws rectangles (a square is just a rectangle with width == height), triangles, and circles into a LedMatrix.loadFrame(int, int, int) word, either filled solid or as a 1-pixel border outline. Callers OR the result into the same word0/word1/ word2 triple as LedMatrixText glyphs, then pass all three to loadFrame. Combine with LedMatrixTransform to rotate a shape's points before drawing it.
